p: Active fire station; interior not open to public
Although built in 1995, this fire hall has a quaint old-fashioned look.
Ward's Island offers views of the eastern side of the harbour which is more industrial on the other side of the water.
There is a footbridge connecting Centre Island to Algonquin Island. The north side of the island has great views of the Toronto skyline.
Mon-Thu noon-8PM, Fri-Sun, noon-9PM (hours vary during shoulder season holidays; closed in late December and early January)
Lovely place to eat outside in the summer time. Licensed to serve alcoholic beverages.
It serves pastries, hot and cold drinks at the cafe kiosk. The restaurant is reopening in mid-May 2025.
